The '''HWK-2000''' was a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] created by [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|Corellian Engineering Corporation]] sometime before [[Darth Krayt]]'s reign as [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]].

==Behind the scenes==
The HWK-2000 was only mentioned in the ''[[Legacy Era Campaign Guide]]'', as a way to bridge a player's interest in [[HWK-290 light freighter/Legends|more familiar ships]] and to show evolving designs. It was never given stats in the sourcebook, and mentioned only as something a GM could do, much like the [[C-wing]] from the first ''[[Starships of the Galaxy]]'', but considerably less detailed.
